item.title: CELTIC STEP UP STRIKER SEARCH
item.description: CELTIC have stepped up their search for a striker with a move for Lorient striker Mohamed Bamba. The Ivory Coast frontman has emerged as a priority target for Martin O’Neill who is lining up a loan-to-buy deal for the 24-year-old international who is valued in the £5million region. item.description: STEVEN McLEAN will be in charge of Celtic’s vital Premiership clash against Hearts at Tynecastle on Sunday. item.title: Winning mindset
item.description: In several of Martin O’Neill’s 11 games in charge this season Celtic have been poor, the recent outing at Falkirk a case in point. What’s clear, though, is Martin’s winning mindset. item.title: CELTIC IN ASPRILLA LINK
item.description: CELTIC have been linked with Girona winger Yaser Asprilla as Martin O’Neill continues to search for reinforcements. The 22-year-old £10million-rated Columbian international joined the Spanish club from Watford in the summer of 2024 and has scored three goals in 36 appearances. item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL hopes to have the loan signing of striker Tomas Cvancara from Borussia Monchengladbach rubberstamped in time for the crucial Premiership encounter with Hearts at Tynecastle on Sunday. item.description: FORMER Celtic keeper Michael McGovern has returned to the club in a coaching role.
